scenes.big: Can't see well in the dark?
scenes.en: The answer may be on your plate.
scenes.say: Struggling to see when the lights go dim? The answer might be on your plate.

scenes.en: Your retina needs vitamin A to see in dim light.
scenes.ta: இருட்டில் பார்க்க விழித்திரைக்கு வைட்டமின் A தேவை
scenes.say: Number three. Your retina uses vitamin A to make a special pigment that lets you see in dim light. Without enough vitamin A, night vision fades first.

scenes.en: WHO: vitamin A deficiency is the leading preventable cause of blindness in children.
scenes.ta: குழந்தைகளின் தடுக்கக்கூடிய பார்வை இழப்புக்கு இது முக்கிய காரணம்
scenes.say: Number two. Did you know? The World Health Organization says vitamin A deficiency is the leading preventable cause of blindness in children.

scenes.en: A child stumbles in dim light, or has very dry eyes.
scenes.say: Early signs include a child stumbling or bumping into things in the evening, and very dry eyes.

scenes.en: Carrot, papaya, mango, sweet potato, keerai, eggs, milk.
scenes.ta: கேரட், பப்பாளி, மாம்பழம், கீரை, முட்டை, பால்
scenes.say: Number one. Eat the colours. Carrots, papaya, mango, sweet potato, green leafy vegetables, eggs and milk are rich in vitamin A.

scenes.en: No vitamin supplements without a doctor's advice. Too much can harm.
scenes.say: Don't give vitamin supplements without a doctor's advice. Too much vitamin A can also be harmful.

scenes.en: Night vision gets worse, or eyes look very dry or cloudy.
scenes.ta: இரவுப் பார்வை குறைந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: If night vision gets worse, or the eyes look very dry or cloudy, see an eye specialist without delay.

scenes.en: Night blindness has other causes too.
scenes.say: Night blindness can have other causes too. So book an eye test today.
